values.task_boundary: Deliver a browser-trusted local Observatory HTTPS flow with reproducible browser and health proof.
deliverables: Supported certificate issuance, trust, renewal or reissue, and startup flow
Chrome, curl, HTML, Runtime-feed, configuration, and documentation evidence
acceptance_criteria: Chrome loads the supported Observatory URL without certificate warnings or bypasses
The chosen certificate has correct localhost names and valid trust/expiry behavior
Startup, configuration, docs, URLs, and health checks consistently use HTTPS
Observatory HTML and Runtime feed succeed through verified TLS
Expired, mismatched, missing, or untrusted certificates fail truthfully without deleting the last valid pair
Certificate private material is not committed or logged
macOS local proof is retained and Windows/Linux setup is implemented or explicitly bounded by supported portable behavior
One exact-revision review has no unresolved actionable findings
